subject: Log cost allocation & archive slicing for renewal discussions
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Log cost allocation & archive slicing for renewal discussions

Samantha —

We are starting renewal planning for our observability stack (Datadog for logs/metrics, Grafana Cloud dashboards, Sentry for error telemetry). Before legal/procurement loops in I want to align on two asks so we can present a clean proposal internally:

1) A per-line-item pricing breakout by product and retention tier: hot (0–7d), warm (8–30d), cold (31–90d), archive (>90d). Please include both list-price and committed/annual-commit discounted pricing.

2) Options for invoice-level cost allocation (chargeback) by tags: service, environment, and team. Example: we'd like a CSV export or billing view that can split Datadog logs costs across product teams. If there are API endpoints we can pull for chargeback, call those out.

We have a couple of constraints:
- We need an option to reduce retention for high-volume debug logs to 15 days without affecting critical audit logs.
- We want to test a pilot where infra logs are archived after 30 days and app logs kept for 90 days — need the cost delta.

Can you send a short quote (line items preferred) and any recommended lifecycle policies by EOD Thursday (24 Jun)? Attaching our internal allocation template so you can map fields.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_log_allocation_template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acme-payments.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Billing <billing@acme-payments.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Log cost allocation & archive slicing for renewal discussions

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear ask — appreciate the template. Attached is an initial quote that breaks out Datadog logs, Grafana Cloud metrics/storage, and Sentry events by retention tier. High-level notes:

- Datadog Logs: list price $0.40/GB ingest; warm/cold discounts apply at commit levels. 12-month commit (X TB/mo) -> 18% discount; 24-month -> 25%.
- Grafana Cloud: metrics storage priced separately; we can do tiered retention buckets and provide cold storage export to S3.
- Sentry: event retention add-on available; we can tier error events by project.

We included two lifecycle proposals: (A) conservative (archive after 90 days for infra; app 90d), (B) aggressive (infra 30d archive, app 90d). See the attachment for line items and a modeled monthly cost comparison.

Early-signing incentive: if you commit to 12 months and execute a PO by 2027-07-15, we can extend a 20% credit to the first three months of usage (applied as an invoice credit).

We can also expose a billing export filtered by tags; we'll include an example CSV in the next email.

Appended: acme_datadog_grafana_quote_Q3_2027.pdf (PDF, 78KB)

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Enterprise Sales — Observability
Acme Payments

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Log cost allocation & archive slicing for renewal discussions

Folks —

Reviewing Samantha's quote. A few internal asks before we go back:

- We need the vendor to provide a sample month-of-billing CSV broken down by tag keys we already use (service_name, env, team). "team" is critical for our finance chargeback.
- Split the quote into two invoices: (1) core platform (Datadog + Grafana) billed to Infra (internal cost center INF-PLAT), (2) product-specific add-ons (Sentry, alerts pricing) billed to product orgs. The vendor must be able to issue two POs or a single invoice with line-level GL codes.
- Confirm if the archive export to S3 incurs egress fees on the vendor side or if those are billed separately.

Proposing a 30-min alignment call (vendor + finance + infra) next week; I can take Wednesday 2027-06-30 10:00–10:30 PT. Marcus, can you coordinate?

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Procurement Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Log cost allocation & archive slicing for renewal discussions

+1 to Laura's split approach. Also:

- For quick wins, negotiate retaining debug-level logs at 15 days (not 30) for low-value services. That should shave a big chunk off egress/ingest.
- We should ask for a custom retention policy mapping when we hit commit tiers; vendors sometimes allow per-index rules under commit.

I'll add our cost model to the drive folder (link in metadata) and prep questions for the alignment call.

— Grace
Senior Product Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Finance Billing <billing@acme-payments.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Log cost allocation & archive slicing for renewal discussions

Samantha —

Thanks for the quote and the early-signing credit — that incentive makes sense. Next steps from our side:

1) Please provide a sample billing export CSV mapped to our tag keys (service_name, env, team) and an example invoice with GL-code line mapping.
2) Update the attached quote to show two presentation formats: (A) single consolidated invoice with line-level GL codes, and (B) split invoicing option (Infra vs Product).
3) Reflect two retention pilots in the pricing model: Pilot A (infra debug logs -> 15d hot/warm, archive after 30d), Pilot B (infra debug logs -> 30d hot/warm, archive after 90d).
4) Confirm whether S3 export/egress is billed separately and any expected per-GB fees.

We want to run the alignment call on Wed 2027-06-30 10:00–10:30 PT — can you confirm availability and invite the right billing/solutions engineer? If you can turn around the updated quote and CSV prior to the call that would be ideal.

Linking the HubSpot deal for context: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/HS12345/deal/DEAL-89234

I'll draft a short mutual action plan after the call and share a PO template if the numbers look good.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_datadog_grafana_quote_Q3_2027.pdf (PDF, 78KB)
